instructor: Overall, Mr. Tsarouhas is a very knowledgeable and a wise instructor; however, sometimes he has the tendency to have a rough rhetoric towards students. He can be kind time to time, yet when he talks in a rough way it can result students to be more uncourageous about the class. I still believe he does this to push students to work harder and put more effort on the subjects. However, mostly it results students having doubts over their work/performance in the programme.

It sometimes becomes too hard for the student to participate in the class because of his attitude since you don’t know how he is going to react. He is sometimes really kind and friendly, but there are times that his attitudes are harsh on students. As a professor, I think, he is great and he knows a lot, his way of teaching is also great. But there are also problems. He doesn’t want his slides to be photographed. The problem lies here on the issue that you either should write what is written on the slides or listen to him. So either way, you lose quite amount of info. Besides, it would be more useful to benefit from the slides and to listen to him directly in the class instead of writing what is written on the slides. Besides, for this course, we had 4 hours a week, and he went over for every subject very fast, which made the learning process very hard. Because on 14th of January we are going to have our final exam and for the last three weeks we won’t have lectures apart from student presentations :). In regards to presentations, I think his grading was not enough. We should be graded more leniently, since it is a group presentation and some students do have less responsibility and even though we are graded individually, their attitudes also effect us since we don’t know them :). As I mentioned before, as a professor, he is amazing and great and he makes you learn a lot. He draws the intention for the class. But I wish he would be more friendly on students :(, and more open and helpful over the issues I mentioned above.
